services.name: Manatee Tours
services.desc: The Perfect Tour for those who do not wish to swim but would love to enjoy the natural wildlife that call Crystal River home. This tour is approximately 1 hour - 1 1/2 hours long. Visit Kings Bay, where the manatees call home! Upwards of 1200 manatees visit the local Crystal River Springs each winter and some manatees call this area “home” year-round! Join our Kings Bay Manatee Watching Cruise for just $39 per person. Offering the most dry and comfortable riding vessel on the bay! Experience all of the wildlife and wonders located in Kings Bay during our 1-1 1/2 hour Nature Cruise. services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Experience the enchanting beauty of King's Bay at dusk on our Sunset Cruise. Glide along tranquil waters as the sun sets, casting a golden glow over the horizon, creating a mesmerizing backdrop for spotting native wildlife and soaking in the serenity of nature's evening spectacle. Conducted year-round, seven days a week, our Kings Bay Sunset Cruise is $39 per person. Our boat is covered, warm and designed for optimal comfort, ensuring a cozy experience in any season. The tour, lasting approximately 1 to 1 1/2 hours, invites you to the heart of Crystal River-the global epicenter of manatee activity, but also home to so many other magnificent creatures you may encounter on your tour!
